title: carex pseudocyperus subsp. haenkeana
intro: Carex pseudocyperus subsp. haenkeana, commonly known as Haenke's sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. Research suggests that Haenke's sedge has several health benefits, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in alleviating symptoms associated with various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Haenke's sedge, although not extensively studied, may include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents of Haenke's sedge.
